# create-boost-app — Full AI Agent Manifest (v1.1.0)

`create-boost-app` is the official scaffolding CLI for the BoostEngine ecosystem.
It lets coding agents (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, Antigravity) and developers
generate production-ready eCommerce stores and headless backends with all 23
`@boostengine/*` packages pre-wired.

---

## 1. Invocation

Two binaries map to the same CLI:

```bash
npx create-boost-app <project-name>
npx create-boost-store <project-name>
```

Without arguments the CLI runs interactively: ASCII banner → project name →
brand title → stack menu → feature selection.

---

## 2. Templates

| Template | Framework | Description |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| `nextjs` | Next.js 15 App Router | Full-stack storefront + admin panel (MongoDB, GST math) |
| `vite-store` | Vite + React 19 | SPA storefront (frontend only) |
| `expo-mobile` | Expo / React Native | Mobile app: native screens, UPI sheets, cart, push notifications |
| `backend-express` | Express | Headless REST API microservice |

Paired stacks (also available): `web+app`, `vite+express`, `expo+express`,
`omnichannel`.

---

## 3. Flags

```
--template <nextjs | vite-store | expo-mobile | backend-express>
--pm <npm | pnpm | yarn | bun>
--git | --no-git
--install | --no-install
--features <all | essentials | payments,shipping,auth,...>
```

- `--pm` selects the package manager used in generated README/next-steps and by
  `--install`.
- `--git` runs `git init` after scaffold (default: off).
- `--install` runs the package-manager install after scaffold (default: off).
- `--features` filters which `@boostengine/*` plugins are wired into the store.

---

## 4. Generated files

Every scaffold writes:

- `package.json` — project name derived from the user's `<project-name>`.
- `.env.example` — placeholders for Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe, Shiprocket,
  JWT, MongoDB, and notifications.
- `.gitignore` — `node_modules`, `.next`, `dist`, `.env*`, etc.
- `README.md` — brand-customized quick-start with the selected package manager.
- `boost.config.json` — records which plugins are enabled.

---

## 5. Template dependency versions (v1.1.0)

- **nextjs**: `@boostengine/ui@^2.1.1`, `@boostengine/core@^1.1.0`, plus
  `analytics`, `auth`, `cart`, `coupons`, `payments`, `reviews`, `search`,
  `seo`, `shipping`, `wishlist` at `^1.1.0`; `react@^19.0.0`, `next@^15.0.0`.
- **vite-store**: `@boostengine/ui@^2.1.1`, `@boostengine/core@^1.1.0`,
  `@boostengine/cart@^1.1.0`, `@boostengine/payments@^1.1.0`; React 19.
- **expo-mobile**: `@boostengine/core@^1.1.0`, `@boostengine/cart@^1.1.0`,
  `@boostengine/payments@^1.1.0`, `expo-notifications` (push).
- **backend-express**: `@boostengine/server@^1.1.0`, `@boostengine/core@^1.1.0`,
  `@boostengine/payments@^1.1.0`, `@boostengine/shipping@^1.1.0`,
  `@boostengine/invoicing@^1.1.0`, `@boostengine/returns@^1.1.0`.

---

## 6. Programmatic API

```js
const { scaffoldProject, scaffoldPair, TEMPLATES, PAIRS, FEATURES } = require('create-boost-app/src/scaffolder');

scaffoldProject(targetDir, {
  storeName, brandTitle, template, features, pm, git, install
});
// -> { success, targetDir, template, framework, features, pm, git, install }

scaffoldPair(baseDir, pair, { storeName, brandTitle, features });
```
